request: Proactively translate the RSO modules/callbacks that fail with 'Missing translated function' as the story advances, instead of discovering them one by one in manual QA
principle: A relocatable module cannot hold an absolute code address without a relocation. Every indirectly reachable entry (prolog/epilog/unresolved, ctors/dtors, exports, vtable/data pointers, HA/LO callbacks) is listed by the module's own relocation tables; the only relocated text targets that are not entries are switch case labels, recognised by the dispatch that indexes them (addi table@l -> lwzx -> mtctr -> bctr) and bounded by the cmplwi/bgt guard, with one relocation per entry.

changes.recomp/tools/discover_prime_rso_roots.py: Static root and jump-table discovery for any RSO; validated on the 13 reviewed modules: every manually curated root is found automatically (plus 38 not yet reached ones, all real function starts) and the manually excluded switch tables (Friendly 16, MapScreen 34) are found.
changes.recomp/config/RM3E01_00/rso_modules.json: Central table of the 74 disc modules: id, descriptor symbol, RSO sha256 and deterministic synthetic REL sha256. Ids/symbols of the first 13 unchanged.
changes.recomp/tools/prepare_prime_rso_translati: Table-driven; adds the discovered roots to the reviewed ones (kept as assertions: reviewed roots must be a subset) and passes relocation-proven jump tables to the translator.
changes.Translator.Core JumpTableDetector: JumpTableOverrides (bctr -> targets) consulted before the bound heuristic; empty by default; overrides must stay inside the function window or translation fails.
changes.recomp/tools/RsoRuntimeTranslator: Applies module jump tables and fails if a reached switch leaves a case label untranslated. --dol-repair loads recomp/config/RM3E01_00/dol_jump_tables.json.
changes.recomp/tools/emit_prime_rso_registry.py,: Read the central table; the wrapper writes recomp/.tools/rso-runtime/modules.cmake for CMake (fallback: the previous 13).
changes.recomp/tools/audit_prime_dol_switches.py: Audit of 204 MWCC switch dispatches in main.dol: 19 functions (26 dispatches) had translated switches missing guard-bounded cases (e.g. 0x802E6D20: cmplwi r4,9 -> 10 cases, 3 emitted). They are retranslated through the existing DOL repair path; prepare_prime_runtime_hooks.py checks every original table entry against the DOL and the repaired cases.

results.covered_nonzero_text_words: 871265 / 871490 (99.974%); the rest are unreachable blr/b after unconditional branches and one unreferenced DarkSamus function (text+0x18264, no relocation or branch reaches it)
results.module_identification: section-size signatures unique across the 74 modules
results.rso_switch_fix_example: DarkSamus text+0xE290: heuristic emitted 1 of 16 cases; relocation-proven table restores all 16
results.dol_switch_audit: 19 functions repaired; re-audit 0 functions with missing cases

limits: Translation coverage is not runtime validation: later areas still need play to exercise graphics/HLE paths and module lifecycle. Not a matching reconstruction of the RSO classes. The DOL switch audit is heuristic (no relocations in the DOL).
